mentions.name: Who Do You Know Here
mentions.description: An invite-only forum application positioned as a cross between Reddit and Discord. Communities can only be joined via an invitation link (global membership doesn't require one), with invitations limited to one per user per community per day. The invite-only architecture is designed to reduce trolls, spam, and AI slop and promote more substantive discussions. Ongoing work focuses on expanding community creation and invitation logic, including bulk invites and flexible invitation cooldowns.
mentions.problem: Open online forums suffer from trolls, spam, and AI slop; invite-only communities promote more substantive discussions.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been ramping up development of https://whodoyouknowhere.io

It is a forum application where each community is invite only. Think a cross between reddit/discord. The invite only architecture reduces trolls, spam, AI slop and promotes more substantive discussions.
